text: All intended (docs/design/tools/illink/task-cache.md). The child linker's runtime/CoreLib is deliberately not identified, since MSBuild's runtime does not establish it and roll-forward does not identify CoreLib; clear or isolate the cache path after a runtime change. Hits do not replay warnings, so disable caching where a warning gate needs them. Arbitrary ExtraArgs bypass because they can bring undeclared inputs, outputs or side effects; only the --ignore-link-attributes shape is supported.
